messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["donkey"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A slender brown equine shown in full right-facing side profile, with a long narrow head, very long upright ears, a short dark bristly mane on its neck, a uniform brown coat with a white muzzle and paler underparts, four long slender legs ending in single hooves, and a thin hanging tail tipped with a dark tuft.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "long narrow brown head with white muzzle and dark eye", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "very long upright pointed ears with dark tips and pale inner fur", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "dark eye with a pale ring around it", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "short upright dark brown bristly hair", "part": "mane", "where": "along the top of the neck"}, {"looks_like": "long slender brown legs with paler inner sides", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the chest at the front and two under the hips at the rear"}, {"looks_like": "single-toed grayish hooves", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "thin hanging tail with a dark hair tuft at the end", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "white on the muzzle and around the eye, and pale on the underbelly and inner legs", "part": "markings", "where": "on the face and underside of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
